RESOLVED 2026-10-07 (iteration efficiency, systemic): the repeated full-matrix re-walk came from having no mechanism that computes an affected set, so a declared surface with no key-level evidence binding degraded into 'rerun everything'. Fixed as a systemic, check-agnostic reuse authority rather than a per-check cache: (1) scripts/ops/evidence_scope.py owns the only reusable/affected/blocked decision for any declared-unit surface, executes nothing, forbids recording a unit the run did not execute and forbids skipping a planned unit, and only carries forward passed/checked/declared/reused outcomes; scripts/ops/test_evidence_scope.py (25 tests, make verify.frontend.business_entry.evidence_scope.unit) locks the semantics. (2) All frontend_/business-entry execution and planning import one pure model (scripts/verify/business_entry_matrix_model.mjs); the declaration-driven matrix is declared as one unit per entry with the declaration row, overlay behaviour, derived denied-role plan and model/probe revisions in its fingerprint, and a served-bundle revision is provenance, not a validity key, so a redeploy alone never invalidates the set (an impact analysis does, as for any reuse). (3) New reuse-first entry make verify.frontend.business_entry.matrix.incremental plans first, executes only the affected key set through the unchanged probe, then records; re-running a covered key is DENIED without SC_ENTRY_SCOPE_REVERIFY_REASON and a whole-matrix re-walk is DENIED without SC_ENTRY_SCOPE_FULL=1 plus SC_ENTRY_SCOPE_FULL_REASON; the raw verify.frontend.business_entry.matrix.browser target stays as the executor. (4) The read-only closure diagnostic adopts an already-recorded observation via SC_ENTRY_MATRIX_CLOSURES_FROM instead of re-walking the ten principal logins, and frontend_dev_incremental.py maps the matrix/engine files to the engine unit test so ci.local.iteration recommends the owning check. Demonstrated on served ce8b77bf/sc_demo without re-collecting: the ledger was seeded from already-recorded runs (daily-ce8b77bf-negative-19, daily-ce8b77bf-negative-delta2 and the f4279416 full run re-derived from its own recorded candidate set) plus the declaration for other-lane entries; plan then reported 85 reusable / 4 affected, the incremental entry executed exactly those 4 (ok=true entries=4 problems=0 console_errors=0) and recorded them, and an immediate second run reported 89 reusable / 0 affected.
